title: Mauna Loa CO2 1958-2026: Unified analysis of trend regimes, seasonal cycle evolution and forecasting (R Shiny application and data)
description: Single-file R Shiny application reproducing every figure and table of the companion paper: PELT changepoint segmentation of trend regimes, seasonal cycle evolution (harmonic model and STL decomposition), comparative forecasting (SARIMA, harmonic, XGB-hybrid, ensemble, seasonal naive) and 120-month out-of-sample backtesting of the NOAA GML Mauna Loa monthly CO2 record, March 1958 to July 2026.
